details.detail: Aisle face: fluted sliding leaves, open and closed, frames, pulls, wood flanks
Screen wall: 43-in screen, window wing, aisle pier with pill mirror and lamp, cap
Centre pair: board between D/G screens, 2D pier, lowered and raised divider
Seat: back, slate flap, niche with two dome lamps, lavender pillow, armrest
Window console: keypad, handset pod, wood tray, two-level top
Bed mode: pad, duvet, pillows, belt
Colour and materials: taupe shells, fluted field, wood, tweed

issues.issue: The window-wing rounded corner is hidden. The new r 0.08 wood corner sits in front of a SQUARE taupe screen-wall shell, under a square full-width cap that overhangs it. The silhouette still reads as a square box corner. On the real suite the whole screen-wall outer top corner is rounded, and the taupe rim follows the curve down the outer edge.
issues.evidence: Crops of q03 (x 335-375, y 140-200) and q05 (x 345-370, y 140-180) show the cap's square end and the shell's square corner behind the rounded wood. Real: omaat_f7, f60, f11 and f_17313 show a curved outer edge with a big radius and a taupe rim wrapping it.
issues.fix: 09d_suite.js line 42: for !center, build the front-wall shell as gExtrude of an outline with the same r ~0.10 corner at x=-hx (reuse the wp arc logic from lines 60-62, offset by 0.03 to x=-hx). Line 43: start the cap at x = -hx + 0.10 for !center (width w - 0.10, centre shifted +0.05), and add a curved rim: a gExtrude of the arc band (outer radius 0.10, inner 0.085, 0.132 deep) at the corner. Optionally use wr 0.09 at line 60.
